reviews.text: I saw a Korean YouTuber using this one and it’s great for neutral rose makeup. highlighter is so pretty and it’s a jelly texture! colors go on light so no need to worry if it looks heavy. I use this for commute makeup when heading to office.
reviews.zh: 我見過一個韓國 YouTuber 用呢款，佢好適合中性玫瑰妝容。高光好靚，係果凍質地！顏色塗落好淺，所以唔使擔心會好重。我用嚟返公司路上嘅通勤妝。

reviews.text: The images show cool toned but this is super warm toned and really off in color. The quality is lacking. The glitter color is thick and chunky and the other colors are barely pigmented besides the dark brown.
reviews.zh: 圖片見到係冷色調，但係實物好暖色，色差好大。質素欠佳。閃粉色粗粗實實，除咗深啡色之外，其他顏色幾乎冇色素。

reviews.text: compré la número 1 porque me pareció una combinación de colores preciosa que no había visto en otras paletas. La pigmentación es muy buena y bastante construible. las sombras son suaves y fáciles de difuminar. los colores me encantan! el packaging es precioso y el shimmer azul de la paleta es precioso
reviews.zh: 我買咗 1 號，因為覺得係一個好靚嘅配色，係我未喺其他調色盤見過嘅。色素好好，好易疊色。眼影好柔順，好易暈開。我好鍾意呢啲顏色！包裝好靚，調色盤入面嘅藍色閃粉好靚。

reviews.text: The formulation is not consistent, the shimmery shades like the dark brown could definitly be better. The light brown on the other hand had a good formula and it was easy to apply and blend. Overall it's a good product.
reviews.zh: 配方唔係好一致，好似深啡色呢類閃粉色應該可以改善。淺啡色就配方好，容易塗同暈開。整體嚟講係一款好產品。

reviews.text:
These are surprisingly nice ! I'm not really the target in terms of brand image (I'm in my mid thirties and I'm more attracted to posh looking packaging) but I'm glad I tried anyway ! 
The formula is thin, soft and gently pigmented (which I prefer). It's makes a beautiful, easy and fuss free makeup 
I got the shades Beginning and Tan Peach and they look the same as the pictures and the colours compliment well each other. The packaging is plastic but feels sturdy.
reviews.zh: 真係好出色！我唔係呢個品牌形象嘅目標客群（我三十五、六歲，比較鍾意高級感包裝），但係我好高興試咗！質地薄、軟，色素柔和（我鍾意咁），化出嚟嘅妝容好自然、輕鬆、冇負擔。我揀咗 Beginning 同 Tan Peach 呢兩個色，實物同相一樣，而且色調好夾。包裝係膠嘅，但係感覺好堅固。

reviews.text:
This pallet is just WOW a solid 10/10. 
I have very quickly fallen inlove with Laka's products and this pallet is no different. the formula is so soft and velvety. they blend incredibly well and the lighter shades are easily buildable although not much building is needed as they are very decently pigmented. I'd say it's a little more pigment than the usual kbeauty pallet but still not as overwhelming as a western pallet, it's just perfect. 
I can't wait to play around with it more and possibly even order another pallet 🫢
reviews.zh: 呢個調色盤真係 WOW，10/10！我好快就愛上咗 Laka 嘅產品，呢個調色盤都係一樣。質地好柔軟、順滑。推開好好，淺色眼影好易建立色澤，但其實唔使好多層，因為色素已經好好。我覺得色素比一般 K-beauty 調色盤多少少，但係仍然唔會好似西方調色盤咁過分嗌，剛剛好。我好期待玩多啲，甚至可能會再買另一個調色盤 🫢

reviews.text: I love it! The colors are amazing and really wearable. I love the idea of the yellow balm it really warms up the shadows if I want to have something less cool toned. It has a little bit of fallout but I don't really mind it. The shimmers are to die for!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！顏色好靚，而且好啱日常戴。我好鍾意黃色嘅 balm，佢可以令陰影更暖，如果我想要冷調少少嘅感覺。有少少飛粉，但我唔介意。閃粉好靚，正到爆！

reviews.text: I like LAKA products and was thrilled to try the new eye shadow palette. I got tan peach colors which was little sand to orange colors for me. I was hoping for little more neutral but you can control the amount you apply to adjust the color tone. The darkest color has subtle shimmer which is pretty to use as a liner. I like the clear and simple case as well.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意 LAKA 嘅產品，好開心試咗新嘅眼影調色盤。我揀咗 tan peach 色系，對我嚟講偏沙色同橙色。我本來希望中性多啲，但係你可以控制塗抹嘅份量嚟調整色調。最深色有啲細微閃粉，用嚟當眼線好靚。我都鍾意清晰簡單嘅盒子。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
